The Story

Every spring the prickly pear does something nobody expects from a cactus: it blooms. Coral and hot-pink flowers open right between the spines, and for a few weeks the whole desert looks dressed up for Saturday night.

Desert Bloom puts that moment inside an old cowgirl boot — scuffed leather, turquoise stitching, still standing after a lot of miles — framed by a sunset arch, saguaros and red mesas. It’s a western graphic tee for women who’ve worn their boots in. Throw it on with denim shorts for a country concert, tuck it into high-rise jeans for rodeo weekend, or wear it under a flannel when the night cools off.

Original design, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed women’s fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Heather Stone is a 52/48 cotton-poly blend)
  • Lightweight 4.2 oz fabric, pre-shrunk, side-seamed
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Black, Maroon, Military Green, Heather Stone, Natural, White
  • Blank sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras or the US

Questions

Is this a good country concert graphic tee?
Yes. The boot-and-cactus art and relaxed fit go easy with denim and boots for a country concert or rodeo.

Is it cut for women?
Yes. It’s a relaxed women’s fit, and the cowgirl boot art is original western illustration.

What sizes does it come in?
S through 3XL in a relaxed fit.

Is this a cowboy boot shirt or more of a cactus shirt?
Both. The art is a worn cowboy boot full of blooming prickly pear cactus, so it works as a cactus shirt and a western shirt for women in one.

The Story

Mom said nobody leaves the table until they clean their plate. You took that personally. Three iron weight plates, stacked and served on the good china with a fork and knife on the side.

Clean Plate Club is a 1950s diner-ad illustration with CLEAN PLATE CLUB lettered in an arch of cream and faded red above it. It’s a powerlifting shirt for lifters who treat a heavy set like second helpings. Most funny gym shirts stop at a slogan; this one is a whole dinner-table gag for anyone who grew up finishing everything on the plate. Original design, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% cotton (Sport Grey is 90/10 cotton-poly; Graphite Heather is 50/50)
  • Midweight 5.0–5.3 oz fabric with a structured feel
  • Taped neck and shoulders, double-stitched sleeves and hem
  • Sizes S–5XL
  • Colors: Black, Maroon, Navy, Cardinal, Royal, Charcoal, Military Green, Graphite Heather, Sport Grey, White (White can read slightly off-white)
  • Blank sourced from Honduras, Nicaragua, Haiti, Dominican Republic, Bangladesh or Mexico

Questions

Is this a good shirt to work out in?
Yes. It’s a midweight cotton graphic gym tee — great for lifting days and rest days. It isn’t a moisture-wicking performance shirt.

Do you have bigger sizes in this men’s gym shirt?
Yes. It runs from S all the way to 5XL.

What colors does it come in?
Ten: Black, Maroon, Navy, Cardinal, Royal, Charcoal, Military Green, Graphite Heather, Sport Grey and White.

The Story

Some songs only sound right with the windows down. The radio’s a little crackly, the road turns to gravel, and nobody’s in a hurry to get where they’re going.

Dirt Road Radio is that drive: a rusted truck dash with an old AM dial, looking out over a dusty back road, fence posts and rolling hills under a sinking sun. It’s a country graphic tee for women who grew up on country radio, drawn in a retro, worn-in style. Wear it to a country concert with cutoffs and boots, on a lake weekend, or with your favorite jeans on a Saturday.

Original design, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed women’s fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Heather Navy and Heather Stone are 52/48 cotton-poly blends)
  • Lightweight 4.2 oz fabric, pre-shrunk, side-seamed
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Navy, Black, Maroon, Heather Navy, Military Green, Heather Stone, Natural, White
  • Blank sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras or the US

Questions

Is this a good graphic tee for a country concert?
Yes. The old-radio, back-road art and relaxed fit pair easily with denim cutoffs and boots.

Is this a vintage country tee?
It’s new, with vintage-inspired art — the worn, retro look without the thrift-store hunt.

What sizes does it come in?
S through 3XL in a relaxed women’s fit.

Does this work as a country road shirt for a concert?
Yes. A dirt country road runs into the hills past an old truck radio dial, and it makes an easy country concert shirt with denim and boots.

The Story

Remember walking the video store aisles in October, picking the scariest tape on the shelf by its cover alone? The worse the box art, the better the night.

Night Shift is that tape: a beat-up VHS cover reading Midnight Showing, with a grinning jack-o’-lantern glowing under a full moon. It’s a Halloween shirt for horror-movie-night people — the ones with the lights off and the popcorn ready. Wear it to a scary-movie marathon, a haunted house, or all October long.

Original design, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Unisex fit, ribbed crew neck
  • Lightweight 4.5 oz pre-shrunk, ring-spun USA premium cotton, reactive-dyed for longer-lasting color
  • Shoulder-to-shoulder taping, double-needle sleeves and hem, tear-away label
  • Sizes S–2XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, White
  • Blank sourced from Mexico

Questions

Is this a horror movie shirt?
It’s horror-inspired original art — no movie names, characters or logos.

Is it a men’s or women’s Halloween shirt?
Both. It’s a unisex fit, so it works as a Halloween shirt for men or women.

When should I order for Halloween?
Order a couple of weeks early — each shirt is printed after you order it.

Is this a retro horror shirt or a Halloween shirt?
Both. It’s a VHS shirt drawn like a worn rental-tape cover, so it reads as retro horror all year and still fits Halloween.

The Story

Some cats wait all year for October. Witchy Season is for the quiet part of the night after the candles are lit, when the moon is up and the only one still working is the witch.

The art shows a black cat curled up asleep on the brim of a starry witch hat, with an orange ribbon and a little crescent-moon charm, under a big golden moon. It’s drawn in a soft, vintage style, so it reads as a black cat Halloween shirt rather than a costume, and you’ll keep wearing it past the 31st.

Wear it to a pumpkin patch with jeans and a cardigan, under a flannel for a cold football Friday, or on its own for a movie night. Original design, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed women's fit with a crew neck
  • 100% combed and ring-spun cotton; Heather Stone is 52% cotton, 48% polyester
  • Lightweight 4.2 oz/yd² (142 g/m²), pre-shrunk, side-seamed
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Maroon, Forest Green, Sage, Heather Stone, Vintage White
  • Blank sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this a kids’ design?
No. It’s cut in a relaxed women’s fit, and the art is a detailed, vintage-style illustration rather than a cartoon.

Can I wear this Halloween shirt after October?
Yes. A sleeping cat, a witch hat and a moon work all fall, especially in Black, Forest Green or Sage.

Does it come in bigger sizes?
It runs from S to 3XL in a relaxed fit, so there’s room to size up for a looser look.

Is this more of a witchy shirt or a black cat shirt?
Both: a black cat curled up asleep on a witch hat under a crescent moon. It’s a witchy shirt you can wear all fall, not just on the 31st.

The Story

The alarm goes off before the ducks do. Quack of Dawn is the thermos-in-hand, still-dark, decoys-already-set kind of morning, when the first mallards lift off the marsh and the early start finally pays off.

QUACK OF DAWN is lettered in vintage capitals above three mallards lifting off a reedy marsh at sunrise past a small wooden duck blind, a steaming thermos cup resting on its edge. It’s a vintage duck hunting t-shirt for the people who set the alarm for exactly this. Cream ink prints on the dark colors; dark ink prints on Soft Cream and White.

Wear it to camp, on the drive home after a hunt, or around town on the off days. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Dark Grey Heather contains polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–5XL (Military Green and Army run XS–4XL; Soft Cream runs XS–3XL)
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Military Green, Army, Soft Cream, White
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this specifically a duck hunting design?
Yes. The art is mallards lifting off a marsh at sunrise, so it’s designed for duck hunters first.

Does it run true to size?
It’s a classic unisex fit, so most people order their usual tee size.

Is there any text or logo on the print?
Just one line: QUACK OF DAWN in vintage capitals above the ducks and the blind.

Is this a mallard shirt for waterfowl hunters?
Yes. Three mallards lift off a marsh at sunrise past a wooden duck blind, so it’s a duck shirt made for waterfowl season.

The Story

Some bouquets are better drawn than cut. Wildflower Club gathers a mustard poppy, white daisies, a blush poppy, lavender and wheat, tied with a striped rust ribbon and set inside a scalloped navy patch with a cream border, lettered in arched varsity type.

It’s a vintage cropped graphic tee for anyone who’d rather wear a garden than carry one. The hand-drawn-style art and worn-in screen-print texture give it a lived-in, found-at-a-flea-market feel. Pair it with high-rise denim for an easy warm-weather look.

Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, cropped length, ribbed crew neck, dropped shoulders
  • 100% combed cotton (Heather colors are 15% viscose, 85% cotton)
  • 5.3 oz/yd² fabric, pre-shrunk, side-seamed, shoulder-to-shoulder taping, double-needle hems
  • Sizes XS–2XL (2XL offered in Black only)
  • Colors: Black, Mineral, Bubblegum, Bone, Ecru, White
  • Blank sourced from Bangladesh

Questions

How is the crop cut?
It’s a cropped length with a relaxed body and dropped shoulders, made to meet high-rise jeans, skirts or shorts.

Is 2XL available in every color?
No. Sizes run XS–2XL, and 2XL is offered in Black only.

Does it feel heavier than a regular tee?
It’s 5.3 oz/yd² combed cotton, a little thicker than the 4.2 oz tees elsewhere in the shop.

Is this a flower graphic tee?
Yes. A hand-drawn-style wildflower bouquet badge on a cropped, relaxed tee: a flower graphic tee for warm weather.

The Story

Ho ho ho, the way Santa says it on an old greeting card: loud, round and happy. This retro Santa shirt is for the woman who keeps every Christmas card on the mantel until January.

The art shows an original round-faced Santa mid-laugh, rosy cheeks and a fluffy white beard, with a bulging red sack of pink striped and polka-dot gifts slung over his shoulder. HO HO HO bounces across the top in tall, bubbly pink letters, with little pink stars around him. Drawn in mid-century greeting-card style with fine black linework, it’s a vintage Santa shirt in red, pink and cream.

Wear it to the office party, a cookie exchange or the Santa line with the kids, with jeans and a red lip. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Heather Red is 52% cotton, 48% polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Heather Red, Black
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this Santa from a soda ad or a cartoon?
No. He’s an original Santa designed for this shirt in a 1950s greeting-card style, not based on any brand mascot.

Which shirt color shows the pink lettering best?
White and Natural keep it soft and vintage, and Black makes the pink and red pop. On Heather Red the letters read as a tone-on-tone look.

How loose is the relaxed fit?
It’s a women’s cut with room through the body and sleeves, in S to 3XL across all four colors.

Is this a pink Santa shirt?
Partly. Santa wears classic red, but his sack is full of pink-wrapped gifts and HO HO HO is in pink letters, so it reads as a pink Santa shirt on White or Natural.

The Story

Every December the nutcracker comes out of the attic box and takes his post on the mantel. This nutcracker shirt gives him a little more style: someone tied a big pink bow on his hat.

The art is an original toy-soldier nutcracker standing at attention in a red coat with gold buttons, a curled mustache, a white beard and tall black boots. His striped pink-and-green hat is topped with a floppy satin bow, and sprigs of holly sit on either side. The inks are cranberry, blush pink, pine green and mustard gold with fine black linework, so it reads like a preppy, vintage Christmas shirt for women who decorate early.

Wear it to a holiday market, a matinee with your mom or a night of trimming the tree. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Heather Mauve is 52% cotton, 48% polyester; Athletic Heather is 90% cotton, 10% polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Heather Mauve, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is the nutcracker from a ballet or a movie?
No. He's an original toy soldier designed for this shirt, with no ballet company, film or character behind him.

Is there any writing on the shirt?
None. It's art only: the nutcracker, his pink bow and two holly sprigs.

Which color keeps the pink bow bright?
White and Natural show every color crisply. Heather Mauve gives a soft, tonal pink look, and Athletic Heather is a cool grey backdrop for the red coat.

The Story

Every deck has a card for strength. Ours skips the lion and goes straight to the barbell. This tarot card shirt is for the lifter whose future, every reading agrees, involves a heavy bar and a long warm-up.

The art is an original card drawn in old woodcut style: a robed figure stands on a dark hill, pressing a loaded barbell overhead beneath a huge mustard-gold sun, with a crescent moon and two stars in the upper corners and clouds rolling in on both sides. XXI sits at the top of the ornate border, and THE LIFTER is printed in oxblood serif capitals across the footer. The card has its own bone-cream background, so it stays crisp on every shirt color.

Wear it to a meet, a heavy day or the coffee shop afterward. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Dark Grey Heather, Military Green
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this a card from a real tarot deck?
No. The Lifter is our own card, designed for this shirt in a vintage tarot style.

What does XXI mean on the card?
It's the card's number, set at the top the way traditional tarot cards are numbered.

Will the card show up on dark shirts?
Yes. The card is printed with its own cream background, so the gold sun and black linework read clearly on all four dark colors.

The Story

The beach body is pending. It has been pending since about 2019, and he is still putting in the work.

A tanned bodybuilder in retro trunks and a headband hits a double-biceps pose on a patch of sand, a palm tree leaning in on each side and a small hourglass floating at his shoulder. BEACH BODY sits above him and PENDING below, in chunky 1970s lettering in sunset orange and rust. This bodybuilding shirt is a joke for every lifter who is almost there.

Wear it to an outdoor session, a beach workout or a rest day. Four light colors, from White and Natural to Soft Cream and Athletic Heather, so the orange stays warm and readable. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Soft Cream, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is the bodybuilder a real athlete?
No. He's an anonymous character designed for this shirt, so the joke is about the pose and the wait, not any one person.

Why is it only on light colors?
The orange and brown linework reads best on light fabric, so it's printed on White, Natural, Soft Cream and Athletic Heather.

How should I pick a size?
It's a classic unisex cut from XS to 4XL, so take your usual tee size. Go one size up if you want it roomy for warm-ups.

The Story

Every gym has one: first in when the lights come on, last out after the mop bucket rolls through, always somewhere near the dumbbell rack. This gym rat shirt is for that person, and for anyone who has been called one and taken it as a compliment.

The art is an original rubber-hose cartoon rat in a striped tank top and a mustard sweatband, mid-curl with a dumbbell almost as big as his head, sweat drops flying. GYM RAT bounces over the top in bubbly cream, rust and mustard letters, laid out like a faded 90s bootleg tee. The whole shirt is printed in a washed olive green, and GYM RAT shows up again in tall cream capitals across the upper back, under our neck logo.

Throw it over a tank top for warm-ups and peel it off when the working sets start. It's a rat shirt that wears its nickname proudly, and a funny workout shirt that doesn't need explaining. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Oversized, boxy fit with a crew neck
  • 95% cotton, 5% elastane
  • Heavyweight fabric: 8.85 oz/yd² (300 g/m²) with a medium soft feel
  • All-over print: front, back and both sleeves are printed in washed olive, so there are no color options
  • Sizes 2XS–5XL
  • Blank components sourced from Mexico

Questions

Is the rat a character from a cartoon?
No. He's an original character, designed for this shirt in an old 1930s cartoon style.

What's printed on the back?
GYM RAT in tall cream capitals with a mustard bar underneath, below our small neck logo. The sleeves are plain olive.

How roomy is the oversized fit?
It's cut boxy with dropped shoulders, from 2XS to 5XL. Take your usual size for the loose look, or size down for a closer fit.

The Story

Conflict resolution, the old-fashioned way: you hang a heavy bag on a chain and work it out for three rounds.

A patched, taped leather heavy bag in faded red and cream hangs from a chain, a pair of red boxing gloves hooked on beside it. CONFLICT runs across the top and RESOLUTION across the bottom in worn red capitals. It works as a boxing gym shirt for the folks who hit the bag three nights a week, and as a vintage boxing shirt for anyone who likes the look.

Wear it to the gym, the corner bar on fight night or under an open flannel. Four light colors: Vintage White, Natural, Athletic Heather and Silver. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL (Vintage White XS–2XL)
  • Colors: Vintage White, Natural, Athletic Heather, Silver
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this the logo of a real boxing gym?
No. It's an original illustration designed for this shirt, with no gym, promotion or fighter names on it.

What's hanging beside the bag?
A pair of red boxing gloves, hooked on the chain by their laces.

Which color looks most like an old gym poster?
Vintage White and Natural give it a faded-paper feel. Vintage White runs XS to 2XL; the other three go up to 4XL.

The Story

Pull over on an open prairie road at sundown and sometimes there's one standing out in the grass, big as a pickup and not the least bit worried about you. This bison shirt is designed for that moment, when the sun drops behind the hills and the whole range turns orange.

The art is a 1960s park-poster screen print: a lone bison facing straight out of tall prairie grass, a huge striped sun rising behind its hump and layered rust and mustard hills fading back to the horizon, all inside a rounded frame. Underneath, ROAM is set in small, widely spaced capitals. There are no park names or agency marks on it, just the animal and the open country, so it works as a buffalo shirt for road trips, ranch country or anyone who likes big wild things.

Wear it on a long drive west, a camping weekend or a slow morning at home. It's also an easy buffalo shirt for men or women thanks to the unisex cut. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL (Vintage White and Heather Clay XS–2XL)
  • Colors: Vintage White, Natural, Athletic Heather, Heather Clay
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is this from a real national park?
No. It's drawn in the style of old park posters, but there's no park, agency or place named on it.

Bison or buffalo?
It's an American bison. Most folks call them buffalo, and the shirt answers to both.

Which sizes come in every color?
Natural and Athletic Heather run XS to 4XL. Vintage White and Heather Clay stop at 2XL.

The Story

Some rides are about getting somewhere. Others are just about letting the horse run until the sun drops behind the mesas. This wild west shirt is drawn from the second kind, hat brim up and scarf snapping in the wind.

The art looks like a faded 1970s concert tee: an original cowgirl in a turquoise snap shirt and blue jeans, galloping a brown-and-white paint horse across the desert floor in front of a huge striped sunset. Flat-topped mesas sit low on the horizon, and WILD WEST arches over the top in tall retro serif letters striped in rust, mustard and turquoise. It's a cowgirl shirt with a lot of motion in it, and a horse riding shirt for anyone who'd rather be in the saddle.

Wear it to a rodeo, a trail ride or a long weekend out west. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Vintage White, Natural, Heather Mauve
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is the rider from a movie or an old poster?
No. She's an original rider designed for this shirt in a 1970s concert-tee style.

What kind of horse is it?
A paint horse, with the bold brown-and-white patches that make them easy to spot in any arena.

Which color reads most vintage?
Vintage White and Natural give the sunset a faded, sun-washed look. Heather Mauve warms it up, and all four come in S to 3XL.

The Story

Old ranchers nailed a horseshoe over the barn door, open end up, so the luck wouldn't run out. This horseshoe shirt hangs one over a ranch gate instead, for anyone who could use a little extra going into the week.

The art is drawn like a 1950s feed-sack print. A worn iron horseshoe, patched with rust and mustard, sits open end up with a coiled lariat looped around its base. Two long branding irons cross behind it, and the whole thing is framed by a weathered ranch-gate arch with LUCKY HORSESHOE RANCH lettered across the top in navy slab-serif capitals. A few retro starbursts scatter around it like an old motel sign. It's a ranch shirt for a ranch that only exists on your chest.

Wear it to the barn, the feed store or a Saturday at the sale. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL (Vintage White and Heather Clay XS–2XL)
  • Colors: Vintage White, Natural, Heather Dust, Heather Clay
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is Lucky Horseshoe Ranch a real place?
No. It's a made-up ranch name we designed for this shirt, with no real brand or ranch behind it.

Why is the horseshoe open end up?
That's the old ranch tradition: hung with the ends up, a horseshoe holds its luck instead of letting it pour out.

Which sizes come in Heather Clay?
Heather Clay and Vintage White run XS to 2XL. Natural and Heather Dust go up to 4XL.

The Story

The big meal gets all the attention, but the real feast happens the next day, standing at the open fridge with a fork. This funny Thanksgiving shirt is for the people who plan their whole weekend around what's under the foil.

The art is a 1950s diner sign: a scalloped cream badge ringed in teal and tomato red, with a sandwich stacked about a foot tall, layers of sliced meat, lettuce and toast pinned with a little toothpick flag. A slice of pumpkin pie with whipped cream sits on one side and a gravy boat on the other. Leftovers Club runs across the front in bold retro script, with OPEN ALL WEEKEND underneath. Think of it as a leftovers shirt with a membership card attached.

Wear it on Black Friday, to a cousins' game night or for the second round of pie on Saturday. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (Ash and heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL (Vintage White XS–2XL)
  • Colors: Natural, Vintage White, Athletic Heather, Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Is Leftovers Club a real diner?
No. It's a made-up sign we designed for this shirt; there's no restaurant or brand behind it.

Does the badge show up on the gray shirts?
Yes. The sign has its own solid cream background, so it reads the same on Ash and Athletic Heather as it does on Natural.

Will it fit the whole family?
The unisex cut runs XS to 4XL, so everyone at the table can join the club; Vintage White stops at 2XL.

The Story

Some Christmas decorations come out of the attic every year because they look like they always have: the old Santa on the cookie tin, the paper Santa taped to Grandma's door. This merry Christmas shirt is drawn from that memory.

Santa's face fills the chest: rosy cheeks, a red stocking cap with a fur trim, and a full white beard with a crackled, worn finish, like paint that has dried and split on an old sign. There is no circle or box behind him; the beard simply breaks up into the shirt. MERRY CHRISTMAS sits underneath in faded red block letters. It reads as a santa face shirt from across the room and a vintage print up close.

Wear it to the tree farm, the office party or Christmas morning with a flannel over it. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight; lighter colors are slightly sheer
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction, shoulder-to-shoulder taping
  • Sizes XS–4XL
  • Colors: Natural, Soft Cream, Heather Dust, Athletic Heather
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Mexico, Honduras, or the US

Questions

Why do the beard and type look cracked?
That texture is part of the art. It is printed to look like an old, well-loved screen print, so it looks worn from day one.
